summary: Read a row that stores only 0 and 1, together with an integer K. At most K entries that are 0 may be rewritten as 1, and every remaining entry must stay as it is. After the rewrites, find a contiguous span filled entirely with ones whose length is as large as possible, and write that length. The row length is at most 20000. K is an integer from 0 through the row length. A span that is already filled with ones without any rewrite still counts at its real length.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
